records.jp: あ、詩さん。私も話があるんだ！<CR>この間の話……いい案を思いついたよ！
records.en_original: Oh, Uta, there was something I wanted to talk about too! I thought about what you said the other day and I think I have an idea!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Uta, there was something I wanted to talk about too! I thought about what you said the other day and I think I have an idea!
records.en: Ah, Uta-san. I wanted to talk to you too!<CR>I came up with a good idea about what we discussed the other day!

records.jp: いい案、ですか？
records.en_original: You do?
records.en_auxiliary: You do?
records.en: A good idea...?

records.jp: うん。詩さんが言葉だけに頼らなくても<CR>人の気持ちを察することができる方法！
records.en_original: Yeah! I think I have a way for you to understand people's feelings without relying on words alone!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! I think I have a way for you to understand people's feelings without relying on words alone!
records.en: Yeah. A way for you to sense how people feel<CR>without relying on words alone, Uta-san!

records.jp: 人の気持ちを……察する方法、ですか？
records.en_original: To understand their feelings without words...?
records.en_auxiliary: To understand their feelings without words...?
records.en: A way to... sense how people feel?

records.jp: 図書室……ですか？<CR>ここに良い案があるんですか？
records.en_original: The library? Is there something that can help me here?
records.en_auxiliary: The library? Is there something that can help me here?
records.en: The library...?<CR>Is your good idea here?

records.jp: うん。ズバリ「心理学」だよ！
records.en_original: There is! And it is called...psychology!
records.en_auxiliary: There is! And it is called...psychology!
records.en: Yeah. In a word: psychology!

records.jp: 心理学って、人の行動から感情を論理的に分析<CR>するでしょ？　それ、詩さんの参考にならない？
records.en_original: Psychology is the logical analysis of emotions based on people's behavior, right? Doesn't that sound perfect for you?
records.en_auxiliary: Psychology is the logical analysis of emotions based on people's behavior, right? Doesn't that sound perfect for you?
records.en: Psychology logically analyzes emotions from people's behavior,<CR>right? Would that not be useful to you, Uta-san?

records.jp: 心理学……人の行動から感情を論理的に……<CR>たしかに、理解に役立ちそうですね
records.en_original: The logical analysis of emotions... That certainly sounds like it could help me understand people better.
records.en_auxiliary: The logical analysis of emotions... That certainly sounds like it could help me understand people better.
records.en: Psychology... logically analyzing emotions from people's behavior...<CR>That certainly seems as though it could help me understand.

records.jp: こっちの宇宙の本は、美弦さんの愛読書で、<CR>そっちは詩帆さんおススメの料理本……
records.en_original: Mio likes these books about space right here, and over there are Shiho's favorite cookbooks...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio likes these books about space right here, and over there are Shiho's favorite cookbooks...
records.en: These books on space are Mio-san's favorites,<CR>and those are the cookbooks Shiho-san recommended...

records.jp: そっちの本はきららセレクトで、<CR>その辺のラノベは私の愛読書、かぁ
records.en_original: Those are Kirara's top ten, and the light novels in that corner are my personal favorites.
records.en_auxiliary: Those are Kirara's top ten, and the light novels in that corner are my personal favorites.
records.en: Those books are Kirara's selections,<CR>and the light novels around there are my favorites...

records.jp: 「屍神の法則」のノベライズの新刊は……<CR>やっぱ入ってたりはしてないかぁ……
records.en_original: Looks like they still don't have the newest volume of The Death God Theory...
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like they still don't have the newest volume of The Death God Theory...
records.en: The new novelization of The Law of the Corpse God...<CR>I guess it is not here after all...

records.jp: 読むの楽しみにしてたんだけどなぁ……。<CR>……と、今は心理学の本を探してるんだった
records.en_original: I was looking forward to reading it too... Anyways, I wonder where they put the books on psychology.
records.en_auxiliary: I was looking forward to reading it too... Anyways, I wonder where they put the books on psychology.
records.en: I was looking forward to reading it...<CR>...Wait, we are looking for a psychology book right now.

records.jp: ……みなさんが読んだことのある、<CR>好きな本ばかり……？
records.en_original: These are all books that people have read...?
records.en_auxiliary: These are all books that people have read...?
records.en: ...Are these all books everyone has read<CR>and liked...?

records.jp: 詩さん？
records.en_original: Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta?
records.en: Uta-san?

records.jp: ここにある本は、みなさんの記憶にある本<CR>……ということではないでしょうか？
records.en_original: Is it possible that these are all books from everyone's memories?
records.en_auxiliary: Is it possible that these are all books from everyone's memories?
records.en: Could the books here be books<CR>that exist in everyone's memories...?

records.jp: ……！　雫世界はみんなの想いでできた世界……。<CR>そう考えるとあり得るかも……
records.en_original: Oh...! Oasis is a world made of everyone's feelings and memories, so...it's definitely possible.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...! Oasis is a world made of everyone's feelings and memories, so...it's definitely possible.
records.en: ...! Oasis is a world made from everyone's thoughts and feelings...<CR>When you put it that way, that could be true...

records.jp: 前々から図書室にしては変なラインナップだと<CR>思ってたんだよね
records.en_original: I always thought it was a strange selection of books for a library to have.
records.en_auxiliary: I always thought it was a strange selection of books for a library to have.
records.en: I had always thought this was a strange selection<CR>for a library.

records.jp: いやー、すっきりした！<CR>さっすが詩さん、頭いい！
records.en_original: But now it all makes sense! You're so smart, Uta!
records.en_auxiliary: But now it all makes sense! You're so smart, Uta!
records.en: Ahh, that clears it up!<CR>As expected of you, Uta-san. You are smart!

records.jp: そんな……ことは……
records.en_original: That's not...
records.en_auxiliary: That's not...
records.en: That is... not...

records.jp: でも、そーすると困ったなぁ……。<CR>心理学の本、見つかる気が……いや、あるかも！
records.en_original: I guess that means it might be pretty tough to find a book about psychology... Unless...!
records.en_auxiliary: I guess that means it might be pretty tough to find a book about psychology... Unless...!
records.en: But if that's true, we have a problem...<CR>I don't think we'll find a psychology book... Wait, maybe we can!

records.jp: ね、詩さんは？<CR>心理学っぽい本、読んだことってない？
records.en_original: Think, Uta! Have you ever read a book that might have been about psychology?
records.en_auxiliary: Think, Uta! Have you ever read a book that might have been about psychology?
records.en: What about you, Uta-san?<CR>Have you ever read anything like a psychology book?

records.jp: ……過去の私は、私自信を理解することを<CR>諦めていたような気がしています
records.en_original: I think my past self had given up on trying to understand herself and others.
records.en_auxiliary: I think my past self had given up on trying to understand herself and others.
records.en: ...I feel that my past self had given up<CR>on understanding herself.

records.jp: だから……心理学などで、自己分析を<CR>試みたりはしていなかったのではないかと……
records.en_original: So I doubt I would have tried any kind of self-analysis, psychological or otherwise...
records.en_auxiliary: So I doubt I would have tried any kind of self-analysis, psychological or otherwise...
records.en: So... I don't think she would've tried<CR>analyzing herself through psychology or anything like that...

records.jp: そっかぁ……作戦失敗だー
records.en_original: Gotcha... Guess that means we're out of luck.
records.en_auxiliary: Gotcha... Guess that means we're out of luck.
records.en: I see... The plan failed.

records.jp: 何か気になる本あった？　……あ！　恋愛小説！<CR>詩さん、その本に興味あるの？
records.en_original: Did you find a book you wanna read? Oh...! A romance novel! Are you interested in this kind of stuff, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you find a book you wanna read? Oh...! A romance novel! Are you interested in this kind of stuff, Uta?
records.en: Did a book catch your eye? ...Ah! A romance novel!<CR>Are you interested in that book, Uta-san?

records.jp: ……恋という感情は、私には一番理解できない<CR>ものなんです。それで、つい目を留めたんです
records.en_original: Love is the emotion I have the most difficulty understanding. That's why it caught my attention.
records.en_auxiliary: Love is the emotion I have the most difficulty understanding. That's why it caught my attention.
records.en: ...Love is the emotion I have the hardest time<CR>understanding. That's why it caught my eye.

records.jp: 星崎さんは……いえ、みなさんはやっぱり、<CR>恋という感情が理解できるんですよね？
records.en_original: Ao... Everyone other than me understands what love is, isn't that right?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... Everyone other than me understands what love is, isn't that right?
records.en: You, Hoshizaki-san... No, everyone else<CR>understands the emotion called love, do they not?

records.jp: んー。実は私、恋ってしたことないからさ。<CR>私も恋って感情、よく分からないんだよね
records.en_original: Hmm... I've never really been in love, so I don't actually know what it feels like either.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I've never really been in love, so I don't actually know what it feels like either.
records.en: Hmm. I've never actually been in love,<CR>so I don't really understand the feeling either.

records.jp: お話の中にはよく出てくるけど、<CR>ふーん、そーなんだー、って感じ
records.en_original: People always talk about it in books and movies and stuff so I always just kind of accepted it.
records.en_auxiliary: People always talk about it in books and movies and stuff so I always just kind of accepted it.
records.en: It comes up in stories all the time,<CR>and I just think, 'Oh, so that's what it's like.'

records.jp: 私も……そう。<CR>だから、物語をうまく楽しめないんです
records.en_original: I think I feel the same... Perhaps that's why I can't seem to enjoy fiction.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I feel the same... Perhaps that's why I can't seem to enjoy fiction.
records.en: I'm... the same.<CR>That's why I can't really enjoy stories.

records.jp: あ、私もキャラの気持ちが全然分からないと、<CR>もうわけ分かんなくて読めないー！
records.en_original: I know what you mean. A story's no fun if you can't understand how the character is feeling!
records.en_auxiliary: I know what you mean. A story's no fun if you can't understand how the character is feeling!
records.en: Ah, if I can't understand how a character feels at all,<CR>I get completely lost and can't keep reading either!

records.jp: ふふ。星崎さんも、そうなんですか
records.en_original: Hehe, you too, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you too, Ao?
records.en: Hehe. You feel that way too, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: （詩さんがいつも感じてるのって、<CR>そういう気持ちなんだ……！　それなら……）
records.en_original: (That must be how Uta always feels! In that case...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That must be how Uta always feels! In that case...)
records.en: (So that's how Uta-san always feels...!<CR>In that case...)

records.jp: 詩さん。なんか分かった気がする！<CR>感情って、無理に分かろうとしなくていいんだ！
records.en_original: Uta, I think I got it! You don't need to always try to understand how people are feeling!
records.en_auxiliary: Uta, I think I got it! You don't need to always try to understand how people are feeling!
records.en: Uta-san, I think I get it!<CR>You don't have to force yourself to understand emotions!

records.jp: 無理に分かろうとしなくても……？
records.en_original: I don't need to...?
records.en_auxiliary: I don't need to...?
records.en: I don't have to force myself...?

records.jp: うん。いつかさ、たとえば恋とか……<CR>ふっと自分の中に感情が生まれたとしてさ
records.en_original: Yeah. Maybe one day, a feeling like love will just...appear inside you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Maybe one day, a feeling like love will just...appear inside you.
records.en: Yeah. Suppose one day, an emotion such as love...<CR>suddenly appeared inside you.

records.jp: そしたら、今は分からないキャラの気持ちが<CR>分かるかもしれないじゃん？
records.en_original: Then maybe you'll find that you understand how those characters are feeling.
records.en_auxiliary: Then maybe you'll find that you understand how those characters are feeling.
records.en: Then maybe someday you'll understand<CR>how those characters feel, right?

records.jp: ……！<CR>そう、かもしれません
records.en_original: ...! You may be right.
records.en_auxiliary: ...! You may be right.
records.en: ...!<CR>That may be true.

records.jp: だから、自分の中に何か感情が生まれたら、<CR>ゆっくり大事にしてあげればよくない？
records.en_original: So if you ever feel a new emotion in your heart, try to focus on it. Understand it.
records.en_auxiliary: So if you ever feel a new emotion in your heart, try to focus on it. Understand it.
records.en: So if some emotion is born inside you,<CR>would it not be enough to slowly treasure it?

records.jp: あ、あの時あの人も、こんな気持ちだったのかな<CR>……って、思っていけばいいんだよ
records.en_original: And then you can imagine, "Oh that's how this person must have felt back then..."
records.en_auxiliary: And then you can imagine, "Oh that's how this person must have felt back then..."
records.en: Then little by little, you can think,<CR>"Ah, perhaps that person felt like this back then."

records.jp: 気の長い話ですし、私にそんな日が訪れるのか、<CR>よく分かりませんが……
records.en_original: It sounds like it will take a lot of patience, and I don't even know if the day will come in the first place, but...
records.en_auxiliary: It sounds like it will take a lot of patience, and I don't even know if the day will come in the first place, but...
records.en: It sounds like it'll take a long time,<CR>and I don't even know if that day will ever come for me...

records.jp: 星崎さんの言葉、少しだけ分かったような<CR>気がします
records.en_original: I think I understand, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I understand, Ao.
records.en: I think I'm starting to understand<CR>what you mean, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>藁人形<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Straw Effigy<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Straw Effigy<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Straw Effigy<CLNR> memory.
